evidence_summary: Five web search results for PG/hostel accommodations for working professionals in Bangalore were analyzed. All listings describe furnished rooms with AC, Wi-Fi, and in-house food, with monthly rents advertised starting from ₹5,500. Commonly mentioned areas include Whitefield, HSR Layout, Electronic City, and Nagawara. Listings emphasize proximity to bus stops, metro stations, and IT/tech parks. No snippet provides verified availability, exact total costs, lease terms, utility inclusions, or landlord reliability.
